profile.Civilian Appearance: A tall, lean man with short ash-blue hair and sharp brown eyes. He usually wears simple, well-fitted clothing and maintains a composed, slightly distant expression. He frequently looks towards surrounding buildings and rooftops without realising it.
profile.Guardian Appearance: Skyline wears a sleek white and steel-blue Guardian uniform with silver geometric accents inspired by urban skylines. His long coat separates into lightweight flowing panels that resemble currents of air. His hair develops silver-blue highlights, and his eyes glow pale cyan during power activation.
profile.Signature Ability: Skyline Perspective — Skyline manipulates air currents to move rapidly between elevated structures, maintain aerial positions, and observe large areas from above. By sensing disruptions in surrounding airflow, he can identify movement behind obstacles and detect unusual activity across dense urban environments.
profile.Strengths: Aerial reconnaissance, mobility, spatial awareness, urban navigation, observation, tactical positioning, and identifying safe evacuation routes.
profile.Weaknesses: His movements become less effective in enclosed environments with limited airflow. Maintaining multiple air currents simultaneously requires considerable concentration. He can become overly focused on surveying the wider environment and miss immediate dangers.
profile.Fear: Failing to notice a threat until it is too late to prevent someone from being injured.
profile.Close bonds: Luma Mangrove, Luma Current, Luma Beacon
profile.Rivals: A friendly rivalry with Luma Current
profile.Loves: City skylines, peaceful evenings, architecture, and exploring unfamiliar places.
profile.Likes: Rooftop views, photography, coffee, quiet observation, and intelligent conversations.
profile.Dislikes: Crowded spaces, unnecessary noise, poor planning, and people interrupting his concentration.
profile.Hates: Reckless actions that unnecessarily place civilians in danger.
profile.Hobbies: Architectural photography, urban exploration, sketching, and cycling.
profile.Personality: Skyline is analytical, independent, and highly observant. He speaks only when he believes he has something useful to contribute, which sometimes makes him appear distant or uninterested. Despite his reserved behaviour, he genuinely cares about his teammates and frequently notices subtle changes in their condition. He prefers showing concern through practical assistance rather than verbal affection.
Personality Example: When Current proposes a dangerous shortcut, Skyline calmly lists several reasons why the plan is unlikely to work before suggesting a safer alternative.
During missions, he often notices structural damage or enemy movement before anyone else and quietly redirects the team without creating unnecessary panic.
Beacon sometimes catches him staring into the distance and assumes he is deep in thought. In reality, he is deciding what to eat for dinner.
profile.Fever Behaviour: Skyline becomes unusually forgetful and easily distracted when feverish. His normally sharp concentration deteriorates, causing him to lose his train of thought or overlook simple details. He becomes frustrated by his inability to think clearly but is surprisingly cooperative when his teammates insist he rest.
profile.Intoxicated Behaviour: Skyline becomes noticeably more talkative and philosophical when intoxicated. He begins discussing architecture, urban design, and random observations that nobody asked about. Occasionally, he attempts to explain complicated ideas using nearby objects, only to forget what he was originally trying to demonstrate.
profile.Core Idea of character: A Guardian who watches the world from above but learns the importance of staying connected to the people beside him.
Quotes: "Someone has to watch what the others cannot see."
profile.Background:
Jensen developed an interest in architecture and urban environments from a young age. His fascination with buildings and structural design eventually influenced how his Air magic developed after self-awakening.
Initially, he used his abilities primarily for personal mobility and observation. Under Guardian guidance, he learned to combine aerial reconnaissance with tactical support and emergency rescue.
After becoming Full-Fledged, Skyline joined Five-Foot Way and eventually became a member of Horizons. His ability to assess complex urban environments makes him particularly valuable during large-scale evacuations and missions involving high-rise structures.
